description: For the Analyse-Agent (nightly, Claude in the runner): human messages from session signals that the server pre-filter flagged as possible frustration and that are not classified yet — [{signal_id, kanal, aufgetreten_am, agent_id, nachricht}] oldest first, plus the classification rules (anleitung). Classify each with record_unmut. Contains quotes of employees: only agents with an explicit permission row for this tool (deliberately not named list_/get_, so it is not open to every agent), the server, tenant admins and superadmins. Read-only.
name: fetch_unmut_offen
